neighbours.label: the slot just before an expected 'electric/magnetic field' in electromagnetism text (moving through a ___, accelerated by an ___, under the action of ___)
fire: A proton moving through a magnetic field follows a curved path.
The ions were accelerated by an electric field between the plates.
Electrons placed in a uniform magnetic field begin to spiral.
The beam is deflected by a strong magnetic field near the target.
A current-carrying wire inside a magnetic field experiences a force.
The charged droplet hovered in an electric field set by the plates.
Particles subjected to an external magnetic field align their spins.
Under the action of an applied electric field, the ions drift.
quiet: A ball moving through a viscous fluid slows down steadily.
The cart was pushed along the track by a stretched spring.
Marbles placed in a smooth bowl roll to the bottom.
The beam is supported by a strong steel column near the wall.
A block resting on an inclined plane experiences friction.
The balloon hovered in the warm air above the lake.
Bodies subjected to an external load deform slightly.
Under the action of gravity alone, the stone falls.

notes: Peaks on ' a', ' an', ' to', 'ием' right before 'electric/magnetic field'; the output direction promotes ' magnetic', ' electric', ' applied', ' external'. Near misses keep physics and the same frames but no field follows (mechanics).
